@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TestOutcome:
    name: str
    description: str
    passed: bool
    detail: str = ""


class HtmlRenderer:
    """Convierte entidades y resultados en tarjetas HTML para el notebook."""

    # Tarjetas de la red -------------------------------------------------------------
    def network_summary(self, network: RoadNetwork) -> str:
        directed = network.routes
        roads = {frozenset((route.origin, route.destination)) for route in directed}
        one_way = sum(1 for route in directed if not network.has_route(route.destination, route.origin))
        hubs = sum(location.is_hub for location in network.locations)
        return self._card("Red vial cargada", "LogiExpress · Bogotá", self._kpis([
            (len(network), "ubicaciones (V)"), (len(directed), "aristas dirigidas (E)"),
            (len(roads), "vías"), (one_way, "de un sentido"), (hubs, "centros")]))

    def roads_table(self, network: RoadNetwork) -> str:
        rows = []
        for route in network.roads():
            two_way = network.is_two_way(route)
            direction = (self._badge("↔ doble", PALETTE.violet) if two_way
                         else self._badge("→ un sentido", PALETTE.yellow, PALETTE.background))
            rows.append([self._leg(network, route.origin, route.destination), escape(route.street), format_number(route.distance_km, "km"),
                         format_number(route.time_min, "min", 0), direction])
        return self._card("Aristas del grafo", "Vías y sus pesos",
                          self._table(["Tramo", "Vía", "Distancia", "Tiempo", "Sentido"], rows, {2, 3}))

    # Tarjetas de rutas --------------------------------------------------------------
    def route_card(self, network: RoadNetwork, result: PathResult, eyebrow: str | None = None,
                   conditions: RoadConditions | None = None) -> str:
        eyebrow = eyebrow or f"Ruta más corta por {result.criterion.label.lower()} · Dijkstra"
        title = (f"{escape(network.location(result.origin).name)} → "
                 f"{escape(network.location(result.destination).name)}")
        if not result.is_reachable:
            return self._card(eyebrow, title,
                              "<div class='lx-callout'>❌ No existe una ruta entre estos puntos.</div>")
        body = (self._stops(network, result.stops)
                + self._kpis([(format_number(result.total_distance_km, "km"), "distancia"),
                              (format_number(result.total_time_min, "min", 0), "tiempo"),
                              (len(result.legs), "tramos")])
                + self._legs_table(network, result, conditions))
        return self._card(eyebrow, title, body)

    def recommendation_card(self, network: RoadNetwork, recommendation: RouteRecommendation,
                            conditions: RoadConditions | None = None) -> str:
        parts = [self.route_card(network, recommendation.recommended, "⭐ Ruta recomendada", conditions),
                 f"<div class='lx-callout'>💡 {escape(recommendation.reason)}</div>"]
        if not recommendation.routes_match:
            alternatives = [("⏱️ Más rápida", recommendation.fastest),
                            ("📏 Más corta", recommendation.shortest)]
            parts.append("<div class='lx-grid2'>" + "".join(
                self._mini_route(network, label, result, result is recommendation.recommended)
                for label, result in alternatives) + "</div>")
        return "".join(parts)

    def routes_from_table(self, network: RoadNetwork, results: Sequence[PathResult],
                          origin: str) -> str:
        criterion = results[0].criterion if results else Criterion.TIME
        worst = max((result.cost for result in results if result.is_reachable), default=1) or 1
        rows = []
        for result in results:
            route = (" <span class='lx-arrow'>›</span> ".join(result.stops) if result.is_reachable
                     else "<span class='lx-muted'>inalcanzable</span>")
            bar = (f"<div class='lx-bar' style='width:{100 * result.cost / worst:.0f}%'></div>"
                   if result.is_reachable else "")
            rows.append([self._chip(network, result.destination), route,
                         format_number(result.total_distance_km, "km"),
                         format_number(result.total_time_min, "min", 0), bar])
        return self._card(f"Dijkstra · optimizando {criterion.label.lower()}",
                          f"Todas las rutas desde {escape(network.location(origin).name)}",
                          self._table(["Destino", "Ruta", "Km", "Min", f"Costo ({criterion.unit})"],
                                      rows, {2, 3}))

    def matrix_table(self, codes: Sequence[str], cost: Callable[[str, str], float],
                     criterion: Criterion, highlight: frozenset[tuple[str, str]] = frozenset(),
                     focus: str | None = None) -> str:
        """Matriz de costos coloreada como mapa de calor; resalta celdas y el nodo `focus`."""
        finite = [cost(i, j) for i in codes for j in codes if i != j and math.isfinite(cost(i, j))]
        highest = max(finite, default=1) or 1

        def header(code: str) -> str:
            color = PALETTE.yellow if code == focus else PALETTE.muted
            return f"<th style='color:{color}'>{escape(code)}</th>"

        def cell(i: str, j: str) -> str:
            value = cost(i, j)
            if i == j:
                return f"<td style='color:{PALETTE.line}'>·</td>"
            if math.isinf(value):
                return f"<td style='background:{PALETTE.background};color:{PALETTE.line}'>∞</td>"
            style = f"background:{_mix(PALETTE.panel, PALETTE.pink, 0.12 + 0.88 * value / highest)};"
            if (i, j) in highlight:
                style += f"outline:2px solid {PALETTE.cyan};outline-offset:-2px;font-weight:800;"
            return f"<td style='{style}'>{criterion.format(value)}</td>"

        head = "<tr><th>De \\ A</th>" + "".join(header(code) for code in codes) + "</tr>"
        body = "".join("<tr>" + header(i) + "".join(cell(i, j) for j in codes) + "</tr>"
                       for i in codes)
        return f"<table class='lx-table lx-matrix'>{head}{body}</table>"

    def all_pairs_card(self, all_pairs: AllPairsShortestPaths) -> str:
        matrix = self.matrix_table(all_pairs.codes, all_pairs.cost, all_pairs.criterion)
        return self._card(f"Floyd-Warshall · {all_pairs.criterion.label.lower()} en "
                          f"{all_pairs.criterion.unit}",
                          "Costo mínimo entre todos los pares",
                          "<div class='lx-muted' style='margin-bottom:8px'>Fila = origen · "
                          "columna = destino · más rosado = más costoso</div>" + matrix)

    # Explicaciones paso a paso ------------------------------------------------------
    def delivery_card(self, network: RoadNetwork, report: DeliveryReport) -> str:
        best = report.best
        crit = best.criterion
        title = f"Desde {escape(network.location(best.depot).name)} · {len(best.order)} paradas"
        if not best.is_feasible:
            missing = sorted({segment.destination for segment in best.segments if not segment.is_reachable})
            return self._card("📦 Ruta de reparto", title,
                              "<div class='lx-callout'>❌ Con las condiciones actuales no se puede llegar a: "
                              + ", ".join(escape(code) for code in missing) + "</div>")

        numbered = [self._chip(network, best.depot)] + [
            f"<span class='lx-chip'><b style='color:{PALETTE.yellow}'>{n}</b> {escape(code)}</span>"
            for n, code in enumerate(best.order, start=1)]
        if best.return_to_depot:
            numbered.append(self._chip(network, best.depot))
        arrow = "<span class='lx-arrow'>➜</span>"
        sequence = f"<div class='lx-stops'>{arrow.join(numbered)}</div>"

        kpis = self._kpis([(format_number(best.total_distance_km, "km"), "distancia total"),
                           (format_number(best.total_time_min, "min", 0), "tiempo total"),
                           (len(best.order), "paradas"),
                           ("Sí" if best.return_to_depot else "No", "regresa al centro")])

        worst = max((plan.cost for plan in report.plans if plan.is_feasible), default=1) or 1
        rows = []
        for plan in report.plans:
            gap = plan.cost / best.cost - 1 if best.cost else 0
            verdict = (self._badge("✓ mejor", PALETTE.green, PALETTE.background) if gap <= _EPSILON
                       else f"<span style='color:{PALETTE.red}'>+{gap:.0%}</span>")
            rows.append([f"<b>{plan.strategy.label}</b><br><span class='lx-muted'>{plan.strategy.complexity}</span>",
                         " <span class='lx-arrow'>›</span> ".join(escape(code) for code in plan.order),
                         f"{crit.format(plan.cost)} {crit.unit}", verdict,
                         f"<div style='min-width:110px'><div class='lx-bar' "
                         f"style='width:{100 * plan.cost / worst:.0f}%'></div></div>"])
        strategies = self._table(["Estrategia", "Orden de paradas", "Costo", "vs. mejor", "Comparación"],
                                 rows, {2})

        exact = report.plan_for(DeliveryStrategy.EXACT)
        two_opt = report.plan_for(DeliveryStrategy.TWO_OPT)
        if exact is None:
            insight = (f"Con {len(best.order)} paradas la fuerza bruta tendría que revisar "
                       f"{math.factorial(len(best.order)):,} órdenes: usamos la heurística 2-opt.")
        elif two_opt and two_opt.cost <= exact.cost + _EPSILON:
            insight = "La heurística 2-opt encontró el <b>óptimo</b>, revisando muchísimas menos opciones que la fuerza bruta."
        else:
            insight = (f"La heurística 2-opt quedó a <b>{two_opt.cost / exact.cost - 1:.0%}</b> del óptimo: "
                       "las heurísticas son rápidas pero no garantizan la mejor respuesta.")

        segments = [[str(n), self._leg(network, segment.origin, segment.destination),
                     " › ".join(escape(code) for code in segment.stops),
                     format_number(segment.total_distance_km, "km"),
                     format_number(segment.total_time_min, "min", 0)]
                    for n, segment in enumerate(best.segments, start=1)]
        return self._card(f"📦 Ruta de reparto · optimizando {crit.label.lower()}", title,
                          sequence + kpis + strategies
                          + f"<div class='lx-callout'>💡 {insight}</div>"
                          + "<div class='lx-eyebrow' style='margin-top:10px'>Camino real entre paradas (Floyd-Warshall)</div>"
                          + self._table(["#", "Tramo", "Pasa por", "Km", "Min"], segments, {3, 4}))

    def conditions_card(self, network: RoadNetwork, conditions: RoadConditions) -> str:
        """Lista de incidentes activos (`network` = red original, para conocer los nombres)."""
        if conditions.is_empty:
            body = "<div class='lx-muted'>🟢 Sin incidentes: todas las vías operan con normalidad.</div>"
        else:
            streets = {road_key(r.origin, r.destination): r.street for r in network.roads()}
            rows = [[self._leg(network, origin, destination),
                     escape(streets.get(road_key(origin, destination), "")), self._status_badge(status),
                     "arista eliminada" if status.is_closed else f"tiempo × {status.time_factor:g}"]
                    for origin, destination, status in conditions.incidents()]
            body = self._table(["Vía", "Nombre", "Estado", "Efecto en el grafo"], rows, set())
        return self._card("Estado de la red", "🚧 Incidentes reportados", body)

    def comparison_card(self, network: RoadNetwork, comparison: RouteComparison) -> str:
        normal, current = comparison.normal, comparison.current
        if not current.is_reachable:
            verdict = "❌ Con los incidentes actuales <b>no hay forma de llegar</b>."
        elif comparison.changed:
            verdict = (f"🔀 Dijkstra encontró un <b>desvío</b>: {comparison.delay_min:+.0f} min y "
                       f"{comparison.extra_km:+.1f} km respecto a condiciones normales.")
        elif comparison.delay_min > _EPSILON:
            verdict = (f"⏳ La ruta sigue siendo la misma, pero ahora tarda "
                       f"<b>{comparison.delay_min:+.0f} min</b>.")
        else:
            verdict = "✅ Los incidentes no afectan esta ruta."
        grid = ("<div class='lx-grid2'>"
                + self._mini_route(network, "🟢 Condiciones normales", normal, False)
                + self._mini_route(network, "🚧 Con incidentes", current, False) + "</div>")
        title = (f"{escape(network.location(normal.origin).name)} → "
                 f"{escape(network.location(normal.destination).name)}")
        return self._card(f"Impacto en la ruta · por {normal.criterion.label.lower()}", title,
                          f"<div class='lx-callout'>{verdict}</div>" + grid)

    def dijkstra_step_panel(self, network: RoadNetwork, step: DijkstraStep, total: int) -> str:
        crit = step.criterion
        narration = [f"Se saca de la cola el nodo con <b>menor costo</b>: "
                     f"{self._chip(network, step.current)} con <b>{crit.format(step.current_cost)} "
                     f"{crit.unit}</b>. Su costo ya es <b>definitivo</b> 🔒."]
        if step.relaxations:
            items = []
            for relax in step.relaxations:
                weight = crit.format(relax.route.weight(crit))
                verdict = ("<b style='color:%s'>🤝 empate, pero gana en %s → actualizar</b>"
                           % (PALETTE.green, crit.toggled().label.lower())
                           if relax.won_tie else
                           "<b style='color:%s'>✅ mejora → actualizar</b>" % PALETTE.green
                           if relax.improved else
                           "<span class='lx-muted'>✖ no mejora (ya había %s)</span>"
                           % crit.format(relax.previous))
                items.append(f"<li>{escape(relax.route.origin)} → {escape(relax.route.destination)}: "
                             f"{crit.format(step.current_cost)} + {weight} = "
                             f"<b>{crit.format(relax.candidate)}</b> "
                             f"{'=' if relax.won_tie else '&lt;' if relax.improved else '≥'} {crit.format(relax.previous)} · "
                             f"{verdict}</li>")
            narration.append("Se <b>relajan</b> sus aristas hacia vecinos no definitivos:"
                             f"<ul class='lx-list'>{''.join(items)}</ul>")
        else:
            narration.append("<span class='lx-muted'>No tiene vecinos pendientes por revisar.</span>")

        updated = {relax.route.destination for relax in step.relaxations if relax.improved}
        rows = []
        for location in network.locations:
            code = location.code
            state = self._dijkstra_state(code, step)
            predecessor = step.incoming[code].origin if code in step.incoming else "—"
            glow = f"background:rgba(46,229,157,.12);" if code in updated else ""
            rows.append([self._chip(network, code), state,
                         crit.format(step.best_cost.get(code, math.inf)), escape(predecessor)])
        table = self._table(["Nodo", "Estado", f"Costo ({crit.unit})", "Llega desde"], rows, {2},
                            row_styles=[f"background:rgba(46,229,157,.12);" if loc.code in updated
                                        else "" for loc in network.locations])
        return self._card(f"Dijkstra · paso {step.number} de {total}",
                          f"Fijar {escape(step.current)}",
                          "".join(f"<p style='margin:4px 0 8px'>{line}</p>" for line in narration)
                          + table)

    def floyd_step_panel(self, step: FloydWarshallStep, position: int, total: int) -> str:
        crit = step.criterion
        if step.intermediate is None:
            eyebrow, title = f"Floyd-Warshall · paso {position} de {total}", "Matriz inicial"
            text = ("Diagonal en 0 · si existe vía directa <b>i → j</b> se pone su peso · "
                    "si no, <b>∞</b>. Todavía no se permite pasar por ningún nodo intermedio.")
        else:
            k = escape(step.intermediate)
            eyebrow, title = f"Floyd-Warshall · paso {position} de {total}", f"k = {k}"
            text = (f"Ahora se permite pasar por <b style='color:{PALETTE.yellow}'>{k}</b>. Para cada "
                    f"par se pregunta: ¿<b>dist[i][{k}] + dist[{k}][j] &lt; dist[i][j]</b>? "
                    f"→ mejoraron <b>{len(step.improvements)}</b> pares (bordes cian).")
            if step.improvements:
                shown = step.improvements[:6]
                text += "<ul class='lx-list'>" + "".join(
                    f"<li>{escape(imp.origin)} → {escape(imp.destination)}: {crit.format(imp.before)} "
                    f"→ <b>{crit.format(imp.after)}</b> {crit.unit} "
                    f"<span class='lx-muted'>(= {crit.format(step.costs[imp.origin][step.intermediate])} + "
                    f"{crit.format(step.costs[step.intermediate][imp.destination])})</span></li>"
                    for imp in shown)
                if len(step.improvements) > len(shown):
                    text += f"<li class='lx-muted'>… y {len(step.improvements) - len(shown)} más</li>"
                text += "</ul>"
        highlight = frozenset((imp.origin, imp.destination) for imp in step.improvements)
        matrix = self.matrix_table(step.codes, lambda i, j: step.costs[i][j], crit,
                                   highlight=highlight, focus=step.intermediate)
        return self._card(eyebrow, title, f"<p style='margin:4px 0 10px'>{text}</p>" + matrix)

    # Pruebas ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_report(self, outcomes: Sequence[TestOutcome]) -> str:
        passed = sum(outcome.passed for outcome in outcomes)
        items = "".join(
            f"<li>{'✅' if outcome.passed else '❌'} {escape(outcome.description)}"
            + ("" if outcome.passed else
               f"<br><span style='color:{PALETTE.red}'>{escape(outcome.detail)}</span>")
            + "</li>" for outcome in outcomes)
        color = PALETTE.green if passed == len(outcomes) else PALETTE.red
        kpi = (f"<div class='lx-kpi' style='margin-bottom:10px'><div class='v' style='color:{color}'>"
               f"{passed}/{len(outcomes)}</div><div class='l'>pruebas superadas</div></div>")
        return self._card("Calidad", "Pruebas automáticas", kpi + f"<ul class='lx-list'>{items}</ul>")

    # Piezas reutilizables -----------------------------------------------------------
    @staticmethod
    def _card(eyebrow: str, title: str, body: str) -> str:
        return (f"<div class='lx-card'><div class='lx-eyebrow'>{eyebrow}</div>"
                f"<div class='lx-title'>{title}</div>{body}</div>")

    @staticmethod
    def _chip(network: RoadNetwork, code: str) -> str:
        location = network.location(code)
        css = "lx-chip hub" if location.is_hub else "lx-chip"
        return f"<span class='{css}' title='{escape(location.name)}'>{escape(code)}</span>"

    @classmethod
    def _status_badge(cls, status: RoadStatus) -> str:
        colors = {RoadStatus.MODERATE: (PALETTE.amber, PALETTE.background),
                  RoadStatus.HEAVY: (PALETTE.orange, "#ffffff"), RoadStatus.CLOSED: (PALETTE.red, "#ffffff")}
        background, color = colors.get(status, (PALETTE.green, PALETTE.background))
        factor = "" if status.is_closed or status is RoadStatus.NORMAL else f" ×{status.time_factor:g}"
        return cls._badge(f"{status.icon} {status.label}{factor}", background, color)

    @staticmethod
    def _badge(text: str, background: str, color: str = "#ffffff") -> str:
        return f"<span class='lx-badge' style='background:{background};color:{color}'>{text}</span>"

    def _leg(self, network: RoadNetwork, origin: str, destination: str) -> str:
        return (f"<span style='white-space:nowrap'>{self._chip(network, origin)} "
                f"<span class='lx-arrow'>→</span> {self._chip(network, destination)}</span>")

    def _stops(self, network: RoadNetwork, stops: Sequence[str]) -> str:
        arrow = "<span class='lx-arrow'>➜</span>"
        return f"<div class='lx-stops'>{arrow.join(self._chip(network, code) for code in stops)}</div>"

    @staticmethod
    def _kpis(items: Iterable[tuple[object, str]]) -> str:
        return "<div class='lx-kpis'>" + "".join(
            f"<div class='lx-kpi'><div class='v'>{value}</div><div class='l'>{label}</div></div>"
            for value, label in items) + "</div>"

    def _legs_table(self, network: RoadNetwork, result: PathResult,
                    conditions: RoadConditions | None = None) -> str:
        def street(leg: Route) -> str:
            status = conditions.status_of(leg.origin, leg.destination) if conditions else RoadStatus.NORMAL
            return escape(leg.street) + ("" if status is RoadStatus.NORMAL else " " + self._status_badge(status))

        rows = [[str(n), self._leg(network, leg.origin, leg.destination), street(leg),
                 format_number(leg.distance_km, "km"), format_number(leg.time_min, "min", 0)]
                for n, leg in enumerate(result.legs, start=1)]
        return self._table(["#", "Tramo", "Vía", "Distancia", "Tiempo"], rows, {3, 4})

    def _mini_route(self, network: RoadNetwork, label: str, result: PathResult, chosen: bool) -> str:
        badge = self._badge("elegida", PALETTE.pink) if chosen else ""
        return (f"<div class='lx-card' style='margin:0'><div class='lx-eyebrow'>{label} {badge}</div>"
                f"<div style='margin:8px 0'>{self._stops(network, result.stops)}</div>"
                + self._kpis([(format_number(result.total_distance_km, "km"), "distancia"),
                              (format_number(result.total_time_min, "min", 0), "tiempo")])
                + "</div>")

    @staticmethod
    def _table(headers: Sequence[str], rows: Iterable[Sequence[str]], numeric: set[int],
               row_styles: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> str:
        def css(index: int) -> str:
            return " class='num'" if index in numeric else ""

        head = "".join(f"<th{css(i)}>{header}</th>" for i, header in enumerate(headers))
        body = []
        for r, row in enumerate(rows):
            style = row_styles[r] if row_styles else ""
            body.append("<tr>" + "".join(f"<td{css(i)} style='{style}'>{cell}</td>"
                                         for i, cell in enumerate(row)) + "</tr>")
        return f"<table class='lx-table'><tr>{head}</tr>{''.join(body)}</table>"

    @staticmethod
    def _dijkstra_state(code: str, step: DijkstraStep) -> str:
        if code == step.current:
            return HtmlRenderer._badge("★ actual", PALETTE.yellow, PALETTE.background)
        if code in step.settled:
            return HtmlRenderer._badge("🔒 definitivo", PALETTE.pink)
        if code in step.frontier:
            return HtmlRenderer._badge("⏳ en cola", PALETTE.cyan, PALETTE.background)
        return HtmlRenderer._badge("sin visitar", PALETTE.panel_light, PALETTE.muted)


def _mix(start: str, end: str, ratio: float) -> str:
    """Interpola dos colores hexadecimales (0 → start, 1 → end)."""
    ratio = min(max(ratio, 0.0), 1.0)
    a = [int(start[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (1, 3, 5)]
    b = [int(end[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (1, 3, 5)]
    return "#" + "".join(f"{round(x + (y - x) * ratio):02x}" for x, y in zip(a, b))

5.3 Mapas neón (matplotlib)¶

Un único método draw sabe dibujar la red con aristas resaltadas y estados de nodo; los métodos públicos solo deciden qué resaltar. Leyenda de colores en los pasos de Dijkstra:

★ actual 🔒 definitivo ⏳ en cola sin visitar   Aristas: cian = evaluándose ahora · rosa = árbol de caminos.

In [11]:
class NetworkPlotter:
    """Dibuja la red, los incidentes y los estados de los algoritmos (solo matplotlib + dominio)."""

    P = PALETTE
    EDGE_STYLES = {
        "base": dict(color=P.line, width=1.8, glow=None),
        "highlight": dict(color=P.pink, width=3.6, glow=P.pink),
        "examined": dict(color=P.cyan, width=3.2, glow=P.cyan),
    }
    STATUS_COLORS = {RoadStatus.MODERATE: P.amber, RoadStatus.HEAVY: P.orange, RoadStatus.CLOSED: P.red}
    NODE_STYLES = {
        "current": dict(face=P.yellow, edge="#ffffff", text=P.background),
        "settled": dict(face=P.pink, edge="#ffffff", text="#ffffff"),
        "frontier": dict(face=P.panel, edge=P.cyan, text=P.text),
        "unvisited": dict(face="#1d1738", edge=P.line, text=P.muted),
        "hub": dict(face=P.pink, edge="#ffffff", text="#ffffff"),
        "default": dict(face=P.panel_light, edge=P.violet, text=P.text),
    }
    STATE_LABELS = {"current": "Actual", "settled": "Definitivo",
                    "frontier": "En cola", "unvisited": "Sin visitar"}

    def __init__(self, figsize: tuple[float, float] = (9.0, 8.5)) -> None:
        self._figsize = figsize

    # API pública --------------------------------------------------------------------
    def plot_network(self, network: RoadNetwork, criterion: Criterion,
                     conditions: RoadConditions | None = None) -> None:
        fig, ax = self._figure()
        self.draw(ax, network, criterion, conditions=conditions)
        self._finish(fig, ax, f"Red vial de LogiExpress · pesos en {criterion.unit}",
                     self._incident_handles(conditions))

    def plot_path(self, network: RoadNetwork, result: PathResult,
                  conditions: RoadConditions | None = None) -> None:
        fig, ax = self._figure()
        self.draw(ax, network, result.criterion, highlighted=result.legs, conditions=conditions)
        summary = (f"{format_number(result.total_distance_km, 'km')} · "
                   f"{format_number(result.total_time_min, 'min', 0)}" if result.is_reachable
                   else "sin ruta disponible")
        self._finish(fig, ax, f"{result.origin} ➜ {result.destination} · {summary}",
                     self._incident_handles(conditions))

    def plot_routes_from(self, network: RoadNetwork, results: Sequence[PathResult], origin: str,
                         conditions: RoadConditions | None = None) -> None:
        criterion = results[0].criterion if results else Criterion.TIME
        tree = [leg for result in results for leg in result.legs]
        fig, ax = self._figure()
        self.draw(ax, network, criterion, highlighted=tree, conditions=conditions)
        self._finish(fig, ax, f"Árbol de caminos más cortos desde {origin} (Dijkstra)",
                     self._incident_handles(conditions))

    def plot_delivery(self, network: RoadNetwork, plan: DeliveryPlan,
                      conditions: RoadConditions | None = None) -> None:
        """Recorrido del camión; el número amarillo indica el orden de cada parada."""
        fig, ax = self._figure()
        badges = {code: str(n) for n, code in enumerate(plan.order, start=1)}
        self.draw(ax, network, plan.criterion, highlighted=plan.legs, badges=badges, conditions=conditions)
        summary = (f"{format_number(plan.total_distance_km, 'km')} · "
                   f"{format_number(plan.total_time_min, 'min', 0)}" if plan.is_feasible else "no factible")
        self._finish(fig, ax, f"Reparto desde {plan.depot} · {len(plan.order)} paradas · {summary}",
                     self._incident_handles(conditions))

    def plot_dijkstra_step(self, network: RoadNetwork, step: DijkstraStep, ax: plt.Axes | None = None,
                           conditions: RoadConditions | None = None) -> None:
        own_figure = ax is None
        if own_figure:
            fig, ax = self._figure()
        states = {location.code: self._state(location.code, step) for location in network.locations}
        badges = {code: step.criterion.format(cost) for code, cost in step.best_cost.items()}
        self.draw(ax, network, step.criterion, highlighted=tuple(step.incoming.values()),
                  examined=tuple(relax.route for relax in step.relaxations),
                  node_states=states, badges=badges, conditions=conditions)
        if own_figure:
            self._finish(fig, ax, f"Dijkstra · paso {step.number}: se fija {step.current}",
                         self._legend_handles() + self._incident_handles(conditions))

    def plot_dijkstra_film(self, network: RoadNetwork, steps: Sequence[DijkstraStep]) -> None:
        """Tira de fotos de varios pasos, ideal para ver la evolución de un vistazo."""
        columns = 2
        rows = math.ceil(len(steps) / columns)
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(rows, columns, figsize=(14, 6.6 * rows))
        fig.patch.set_facecolor(self.P.background)
        for ax in axes.flat[len(steps):]:
            ax.axis("off")
        for ax, step in zip(axes.flat, steps):
            self.plot_dijkstra_step(network, step, ax=ax)
            ax.set_title(f"Paso {step.number}: se fija {step.current} "
                         f"({step.criterion.format(step.current_cost)} {step.criterion.unit})",
                         color=self.P.text, fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
        fig.legend(handles=self._legend_handles(), loc="lower center", ncol=6, frameon=False,
                   labelcolor=self.P.text, fontsize=10)
        fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.04, 1, 1))
        plt.show()

    def plot_all_pairs(self, all_pairs: AllPairsShortestPaths) -> None:
        matrix = all_pairs.matrix()
        highest = max((v for row in matrix for v in row if math.isfinite(v)), default=0) or 1
        colormap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
            "logiexpress", [self.P.panel, self.P.violet, self.P.pink, self.P.yellow])
        colormap.set_bad(self.P.background)
        fig, ax = self._figure((10, 8.5))
        image = ax.imshow([[v if math.isfinite(v) else math.nan for v in row] for row in matrix],
                          cmap=colormap, vmin=0, vmax=highest)
        codes = all_pairs.codes
        ax.set_xticks(range(len(codes)), codes, rotation=45)
        ax.set_yticks(range(len(codes)), codes)
        ax.set_xlabel("Destino", color=self.P.muted)
        ax.set_ylabel("Origen", color=self.P.muted)
        self._style_axes(ax)
        for i, row in enumerate(matrix):
            for j, value in enumerate(row):
                ax.text(j, i, all_pairs.criterion.format(value), ha="center", va="center",
                        fontsize=8, color=self.P.background if value > highest * 0.62 else self.P.text)
        colorbar = fig.colorbar(image, ax=ax)
        colorbar.set_label(all_pairs.criterion.unit, color=self.P.muted)
        colorbar.ax.tick_params(colors=self.P.muted)
        colorbar.outline.set_visible(False)
        self._finish(fig, ax, f"Floyd-Warshall · costo mínimo ({all_pairs.criterion.unit}) "
                              "entre todos los pares")

    def plot_floyd_improvements(self, steps: Sequence[FloydWarshallStep]) -> None:
        data = [(step.intermediate, len(step.improvements)) for step in steps if step.intermediate]
        fig, ax = self._figure((11, 4.2))
        codes, counts = zip(*data)
        bars = ax.bar(codes, counts, color=self.P.pink, width=0.62)
        for bar in bars:
            bar.set_path_effects([patheffects.withStroke(linewidth=5, foreground=self.P.pink, alpha=0.25)])
        for bar, count in zip(bars, counts):
            ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, count + 0.4, str(count), ha="center",
                    color=self.P.text, fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")
        ax.set_ylabel("pares que mejoran", color=self.P.muted)
        ax.set_xlabel("nodo intermedio k", color=self.P.muted)
        self._style_axes(ax)
        self._finish(fig, ax, "Floyd-Warshall · ¿cuántos caminos mejora cada nodo intermedio k?")

    # Dibujo base --------------------------------------------------------------------
    def draw(self, ax: plt.Axes, network: RoadNetwork, criterion: Criterion, *,
             highlighted: Iterable[Route] = (), examined: Iterable[Route] = (),
             node_states: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
             badges: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
             conditions: RoadConditions | None = None) -> None:
        """Dibuja la red; `examined` (cian) tiene prioridad sobre `highlighted` (rosa)."""
        highlighted_pairs = {(route.origin, route.destination) for route in highlighted}
        examined_pairs = {(route.origin, route.destination) for route in examined}
        emphasized = highlighted_pairs | examined_pairs

        for route in network.roads():
            two_way = network.is_two_way(route)
            if two_way and (route.destination, route.origin) in emphasized \
                    and (route.origin, route.destination) not in emphasized:
                route = route.reversed()            # dibujar en el sentido en que se recorre
            key = (route.origin, route.destination)
            style = "examined" if key in examined_pairs else "highlight" if key in highlighted_pairs else "base"
            status = conditions.status_of(*key) if conditions else RoadStatus.NORMAL
            self._draw_edge(ax, network, route, criterion, style, status,
                            arrow=style != "base" or not two_way)

        for origin, destination, status in (conditions.incidents() if conditions else []):
            if status.is_closed:
                self._draw_closed_road(ax, network, origin, destination)

        touched = {code for pair in emphasized for code in pair}
        self._draw_nodes(ax, network, node_states or {}, badges or {}, touched)
        ax.set_aspect("equal")
        ax.axis("off")
        ax.margins(0.07)

    def _draw_edge(self, ax: plt.Axes, network: RoadNetwork, route: Route, criterion: Criterion,
                   style: str, status: RoadStatus, arrow: bool) -> None:
        spec = self.EDGE_STYLES[style]
        color, width = spec["color"], spec["width"]
        plain = style == "base" and status is RoadStatus.NORMAL
        if style == "base" and not plain:
            color, width = self.STATUS_COLORS[status], 2.8   # vía con tráfico
        start, end = self._xy(network, route.origin), self._xy(network, route.destination)
        annotation = ax.annotate(
            "", xy=end, xytext=start, zorder=1 if style == "base" else 2,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>" if arrow else "-", color=color, lw=width,
                            mutation_scale=18, shrinkA=17, shrinkB=17))
        if spec["glow"]:
            annotation.arrow_patch.set_path_effects([
                patheffects.Stroke(linewidth=width + 8, foreground=spec["glow"], alpha=0.22),
                patheffects.Normal()])
        ax.text((start[0] + end[0]) / 2, (start[1] + end[1]) / 2, criterion.format(route.weight(criterion)),
                fontsize=8, ha="center", va="center", zorder=3,
                color=self.P.muted if plain else color, fontweight="normal" if plain else "bold",
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.22", fc=self.P.background,
                          ec="none" if plain else color, lw=1))

    def _draw_closed_road(self, ax: plt.Axes, network: RoadNetwork, origin: str, destination: str) -> None:
        (x1, y1), (x2, y2) = self._xy(network, origin), self._xy(network, destination)
        ax.plot([x1, x2], [y1, y2], linestyle=(0, (4, 3)), color=self.P.red, lw=2, alpha=0.85, zorder=1)
        ax.scatter((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2, marker="X", s=170, c=self.P.red,
                   edgecolors=self.P.background, linewidths=1.5, zorder=3)

    def _draw_nodes(self, ax: plt.Axes, network: RoadNetwork, states: Mapping[str, str],
                    badges: Mapping[str, str], touched: set[str]) -> None:
        for location in network.locations:
            state = states.get(location.code)
            key = state or ("hub" if location.is_hub else "default")
            style = dict(self.NODE_STYLES[key])
            if not state and location.code in touched:
                style["edge"] = self.P.pink
            ax.scatter(location.x, location.y, s=1700, c=style["edge"], alpha=0.16, linewidths=0, zorder=3)
            ax.scatter(location.x, location.y, s=850, c=style["face"], edgecolors=style["edge"],
                       linewidths=2.5, zorder=4)
            ax.text(location.x, location.y, location.code, color=style["text"], fontsize=8.5,
                    fontweight="bold", ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)
            ax.text(location.x, location.y - 0.52, location.name, color=self.P.muted, fontsize=8,
                    ha="center", va="top", zorder=5)
            if location.code in badges:
                ax.text(location.x + 0.42, location.y + 0.42, badges[location.code], fontsize=8.5,
                        color=self.P.yellow, fontweight="bold", ha="center", va="center", zorder=6,
                        bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.25", fc=self.P.background,
                                  ec=self.P.yellow, lw=1))

    # Utilidades ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _figure(self, figsize: tuple[float, float] | None = None) -> tuple[plt.Figure, plt.Axes]:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize or self._figsize)
        fig.patch.set_facecolor(self.P.background)
        ax.set_facecolor(self.P.background)
        return fig, ax

    def _finish(self, fig: plt.Figure, ax: plt.Axes, title: str,
                legend: Sequence[Line2D] = ()) -> None:
        ax.set_title(title, color=self.P.text, fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", pad=12)
        if legend:
            ax.legend(handles=list(legend), loc="upper left", fontsize=8, facecolor=self.P.panel,
                      edgecolor=self.P.panel_light, labelcolor=self.P.text)
        fig.tight_layout()
        plt.show()

    def _style_axes(self, ax: plt.Axes) -> None:
        ax.tick_params(colors=self.P.muted)
        for spine in ax.spines.values():
            spine.set_visible(False)

    def _legend_handles(self) -> list[Line2D]:
        nodes = [Line2D([], [], marker="o", linestyle="", markersize=11,
                        markerfacecolor=self.NODE_STYLES[state]["face"],
                        markeredgecolor=self.NODE_STYLES[state]["edge"], markeredgewidth=2, label=label)
                 for state, label in self.STATE_LABELS.items()]
        edges = [Line2D([], [], color=self.P.cyan, lw=3, label="Arista evaluada"),
                 Line2D([], [], color=self.P.pink, lw=3, label="Árbol de caminos")]
        return nodes + edges

    def _incident_handles(self, conditions: RoadConditions | None) -> list[Line2D]:
        if not conditions or conditions.is_empty:
            return []
        present = {status for *_, status in conditions.incidents()}
        handles = [Line2D([], [], color=self.STATUS_COLORS[status], lw=3,
                          label=f"{status.label} (×{status.time_factor:g})")
                   for status in (RoadStatus.MODERATE, RoadStatus.HEAVY) if status in present]
        if RoadStatus.CLOSED in present:
            handles.append(Line2D([], [], color=self.P.red, lw=2, linestyle="--", marker="X",
                                  markersize=9, label="Vía cerrada"))
        return handles

    @staticmethod
    def _state(code: str, step: DijkstraStep) -> str:
        if code == step.current:
            return "current"
        if code in step.settled:
            return "settled"
        return "frontier" if code in step.frontier else "unvisited"

    @staticmethod
    def _xy(network: RoadNetwork, code: str) -> tuple[float, float]:
        location = network.location(code)
        return location.x, location.y

5.4 🕹️ Interfaz gráfica: RoutePlannerGUI¶

Una GUI con 7 pestañas construida con ipywidgets. Todo se recalcula al instante cuando cambias una opción, y los incidentes de 🚧 afectan a todas las pestañas. No contiene lógica de negocio: solo llama a RouteService y pinta con HtmlRenderer y NetworkPlotter.

Pestaña Qué hace
🚚 Ruta Ruta más corta por tiempo, por distancia o ⭐ recomendada
🚧 Tráfico y cierres Reporta trancones o cierres y compara la ruta antes vs. después
📦 Reparto Marca varios barrios y obtén el mejor orden de visita (4 estrategias comparadas)
🌐 Desde un origen Todas las rutas desde un punto (árbol de Dijkstra)
🧮 Todos los pares Matriz de Floyd-Warshall + reconstrucción de cualquier par
🎬 Dijkstra paso a paso Animación con ▶ y explicación de cada relajación
🎬 Floyd-Warshall paso a paso Cómo mejora la matriz con cada nodo intermedio k
In [12]:
class RoutePlannerGUI:
    """Interfaz gráfica interactiva sobre los mismos casos de uso que la consola."""

    RECOMMEND = "recommend"

    def __init__(self, service: RouteService, renderer: HtmlRenderer, plotter: NetworkPlotter) -> None:
        self._service = service
        self._renderer = renderer
        self._plotter = plotter
        self._refreshers: list[Callable[[], None]] = []   # se llaman cuando cambian los incidentes
        self._options = [(f"{location.code} · {location.name}", location.code)
                         for location in service.network.locations]
        tabs = widgets.Tab(children=[self._route_tab(), self._incidents_tab(), self._delivery_tab(),
                                     self._from_origin_tab(), self._all_pairs_tab(),
                                     self._dijkstra_tab(), self._floyd_tab()])
        tabs.titles = ("🚚 Ruta", "🚧 Tráfico y cierres", "📦 Reparto", "🌐 Desde un origen",
                       "🧮 Todos los pares", "🎬 Dijkstra paso a paso", "🎬 Floyd-Warshall paso a paso")
        self._root = widgets.VBox([widgets.HTML(self._header()), tabs])

    def show(self) -> None:
        display(self._root)

    # Pestañas -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _route_tab(self) -> widgets.Widget:
        origin = self._dropdown("Origen", self._default("HUB", 0))
        destination = self._dropdown("Destino", self._default("USA", -1))
        mode = self._toggle(extra=[("⭐ Recomendar", self.RECOMMEND)])
        map_out, info_out = self._outputs()

        def update(_change: object = None) -> None:
            if origin.value == destination.value:
                self._fill(map_out)
                self._fill(info_out, lambda: show_html(
                    "<div class='lx-callout'>Elige un destino distinto del origen 🙂</div>"))
                return
            network, conditions = self._service.network, self._service.conditions
            if mode.value == self.RECOMMEND:
                recommendation = self._service.recommend(origin.value, destination.value)
                result = recommendation.recommended
                card = self._renderer.recommendation_card(network, recommendation, conditions)
            else:
                result = self._service.shortest_route(origin.value, destination.value, mode.value)
                card = self._renderer.route_card(network, result, conditions=conditions)
            self._fill(map_out, lambda: self._plotter.plot_path(network, result, conditions))
            self._fill(info_out, lambda: show_html(card))

        self._observe(update, origin, destination, mode)
        return widgets.VBox([widgets.HBox([origin, destination]), mode, self._side_by_side(map_out, info_out)])

    def _incidents_tab(self) -> widgets.Widget:
        base = self._service.base_network
        road = widgets.Dropdown(
            description="Vía", style={"description_width": "40px"}, layout=widgets.Layout(width="400px"),
            options=[(f"{r.origin} {'↔' if base.is_two_way(r) else '→'} {r.destination} · {r.street}",
                      (r.origin, r.destination)) for r in base.roads()])
        status = widgets.ToggleButtons(options=[(f"{s.icon} {s.label}", s) for s in RoadStatus],
                                       style={"button_width": "150px"})
        apply_button = widgets.Button(description="Aplicar a la vía", button_style="danger", icon="check")
        reset_button = widgets.Button(description="Quitar todos", icon="undo")
        origin = self._dropdown("Origen", self._default("HUB", 0))
        destination = self._dropdown("Destino", self._default("USA", -1))
        criterion = self._toggle()
        map_out, info_out = self._outputs()

        def sync_status(_change: object = None) -> None:
            status.value = self._service.conditions.status_of(*road.value)

        def apply_status(_button: object) -> None:
            self._service.report_incident(*road.value, status.value)
            self._refresh_all()

        def clear(_button: object) -> None:
            self._service.clear_incidents()
            sync_status()
            self._refresh_all()

        def update(_change: object = None) -> None:
            conditions = self._service.conditions
            incidents = self._renderer.conditions_card(base, conditions)
            if origin.value == destination.value:
                self._fill(map_out)
                self._fill(info_out, lambda: show_html(incidents))
                return
            comparison = self._service.compare_with_normal(origin.value, destination.value, criterion.value)
            network = self._service.network
            self._fill(map_out, lambda: self._plotter.plot_path(network, comparison.current, conditions))
            self._fill(info_out, lambda: show_html(
                incidents + self._renderer.comparison_card(network, comparison)))

        road.observe(sync_status, names="value")
        apply_button.on_click(apply_status)
        reset_button.on_click(clear)
        self._observe(update, origin, destination, criterion)
        steps = widgets.HTML("<b>1.</b> Elige una vía y su estado → <b>Aplicar</b> · "
                             "<b>2.</b> Mira cómo cambia la ruta (todas las pestañas usan la red con incidentes)")
        return widgets.VBox([steps, widgets.HBox([road, apply_button, reset_button]), status,
                             widgets.HBox([origin, destination, criterion]),
                             self._side_by_side(map_out, info_out)])

    def _delivery_tab(self) -> widgets.Widget:
        depot = self._dropdown("Centro", self._default("HUB", 0))
        codes = [code for _, code in self._options]
        preselected = {"USA", "SUB", "KEN", "USM", "CHA", "BOS"}
        checks = [widgets.Checkbox(value=code in preselected, description=label, indent=False,
                                   layout=widgets.Layout(width="230px"))
                  for label, code in self._options]
        criterion = self._toggle()
        round_trip = widgets.Checkbox(value=True, description="Regresar al centro al final", indent=False)
        map_out, info_out = self._outputs()

        def update(_change: object = None) -> None:
            stops = [code for code, check in zip(codes, checks) if check.value and code != depot.value]
            if not stops:
                self._fill(map_out)
                self._fill(info_out, lambda: show_html(
                    "<div class='lx-callout'>Marca al menos una parada 📦</div>"))
                return
            report = self._service.plan_delivery(depot.value, stops, criterion.value,
                                                 return_to_depot=round_trip.value)
            network, conditions = self._service.network, self._service.conditions
            self._fill(map_out, lambda: self._plotter.plot_delivery(network, report.best, conditions))
            self._fill(info_out, lambda: show_html(self._renderer.delivery_card(network, report)))

        self._observe(update, depot, criterion, round_trip, *checks)
        grid = widgets.GridBox(checks, layout=widgets.Layout(grid_template_columns="repeat(auto-fill, 230px)"))
        return widgets.VBox([widgets.HTML("<b>📦 Marca los barrios que el camión debe visitar:</b>"), grid,
                             widgets.HBox([depot, criterion]), round_trip,
                             self._side_by_side(map_out, info_out)])

    def _from_origin_tab(self) -> widgets.Widget:
        origin = self._dropdown("Origen", self._default("HUB", 0))
        criterion = self._toggle()
        map_out, info_out = self._outputs()

        def update(_change: object = None) -> None:
            network, conditions = self._service.network, self._service.conditions
            results = self._service.routes_from(origin.value, criterion.value)
            self._fill(map_out, lambda: self._plotter.plot_routes_from(network, results, origin.value, conditions))
            self._fill(info_out, lambda: show_html(
                self._renderer.routes_from_table(network, results, origin.value)))

        self._observe(update, origin, criterion)
        return widgets.VBox([widgets.HBox([origin, criterion]), self._side_by_side(map_out, info_out)])

    def _all_pairs_tab(self) -> widgets.Widget:
        criterion = self._toggle()
        origin = self._dropdown("Origen", self._default("SUB", 0))
        destination = self._dropdown("Destino", self._default("USM", -1))
        matrix_out = widgets.Output()
        map_out, info_out = self._outputs()

        def update(_change: object = None) -> None:
            network, conditions = self._service.network, self._service.conditions
            all_pairs = self._service.all_pairs(criterion.value)
            self._fill(matrix_out, lambda: show_html(self._renderer.all_pairs_card(all_pairs)))
            if origin.value == destination.value:
                self._fill(map_out)
                self._fill(info_out)
                return
            result = all_pairs.path(origin.value, destination.value)
            self._fill(map_out, lambda: self._plotter.plot_path(network, result, conditions))
            self._fill(info_out, lambda: show_html(self._renderer.route_card(
                network, result, "Camino reconstruido con Floyd-Warshall", conditions)))

        self._observe(update, criterion, origin, destination)
        picker = widgets.HTML("<b>Reconstruir el camino de un par:</b>")
        return widgets.VBox([criterion, matrix_out, picker, widgets.HBox([origin, destination]),
                             self._side_by_side(map_out, info_out)])

    def _dijkstra_tab(self) -> widgets.Widget:
        origin = self._dropdown("Origen", self._default("HUB", 0))
        criterion = self._toggle()
        play, slider = self._player("Paso")
        map_out, info_out = self._outputs()
        steps: list[DijkstraStep] = []

        def show_step(_change: object = None) -> None:
            network, conditions = self._service.network, self._service.conditions
            step = steps[slider.value - 1]
            self._fill(map_out, lambda: self._plotter.plot_dijkstra_step(network, step, conditions=conditions))
            self._fill(info_out, lambda: show_html(
                self._renderer.dijkstra_step_panel(network, step, len(steps))))

        def recompute(_change: object = None) -> None:
            steps[:] = self._service.trace_dijkstra(origin.value, criterion.value)
            self._reset_player(play, slider, minimum=1, maximum=len(steps))
            show_step()

        slider.observe(show_step, names="value")
        self._observe(recompute, origin, criterion)
        return widgets.VBox([widgets.HBox([origin, criterion]), widgets.HBox([play, slider]),
                             self._side_by_side(map_out, info_out)])

    def _floyd_tab(self) -> widgets.Widget:
        criterion = self._toggle()
        play, slider = self._player("Paso")
        output = widgets.Output()
        steps: list[FloydWarshallStep] = []

        def show_step(_change: object = None) -> None:
            step = steps[slider.value - 1]
            self._fill(output, lambda: show_html(
                self._renderer.floyd_step_panel(step, slider.value, len(steps))))

        def recompute(_change: object = None) -> None:
            steps[:] = self._service.trace_floyd_warshall(criterion.value)
            self._reset_player(play, slider, minimum=1, maximum=len(steps))
            show_step()

        slider.observe(show_step, names="value")
        self._observe(recompute, criterion)
        return widgets.VBox([criterion, widgets.HBox([play, slider]), output])

    # Piezas reutilizables -----------------------------------------------------------
    def _default(self, code: str, fallback: int) -> str:
        codes = [value for _, value in self._options]
        return code if code in codes else codes[fallback]

    def _dropdown(self, description: str, value: str) -> widgets.Dropdown:
        return widgets.Dropdown(description=description, options=self._options, value=value,
                                style={"description_width": "60px"},
                                layout=widgets.Layout(width="300px"))

    @staticmethod
    def _toggle(extra: Sequence[tuple[str, object]] = ()) -> widgets.ToggleButtons:
        options = [("⏱️ Tiempo", Criterion.TIME), ("📏 Distancia", Criterion.DISTANCE), *extra]
        return widgets.ToggleButtons(options=options, value=Criterion.TIME,
                                     style={"button_width": "130px"})

    @staticmethod
    def _player(description: str) -> tuple[widgets.Play, widgets.IntSlider]:
        play = widgets.Play(interval=1800, min=1, max=1, step=1, description="Reproducir")
        slider = widgets.IntSlider(min=1, max=1, description=description,
                                   layout=widgets.Layout(width="420px"))
        widgets.jslink((play, "value"), (slider, "value"))
        return play, slider

    @staticmethod
    def _reset_player(play: widgets.Play, slider: widgets.IntSlider, minimum: int, maximum: int) -> None:
        play.playing = False
        slider.value = play.value = minimum
        slider.max = play.max = maximum

    @staticmethod
    def _outputs() -> tuple[widgets.Output, widgets.Output]:
        return (widgets.Output(layout=widgets.Layout(flex="1 1 56%", min_width="420px")),
                widgets.Output(layout=widgets.Layout(flex="1 1 40%", min_width="340px")))

    @staticmethod
    def _side_by_side(left: widgets.Output, right: widgets.Output) -> widgets.HBox:
        return widgets.HBox([left, right], layout=widgets.Layout(flex_flow="row wrap", width="100%"))

    @staticmethod
    def _fill(output: widgets.Output, render: Callable[[], None] | None = None) -> None:
        """Reemplaza el contenido de un panel de salida."""
        output.clear_output(wait=True)
        if render:
            with output:
                render()

    def _observe(self, callback: Callable[[object], None], *controls: widgets.Widget) -> None:
        """Recalcula al cambiar los controles o los incidentes, y hace el primer dibujo."""
        for control in controls:
            control.observe(callback, names="value")
        self._refreshers.append(lambda: callback(None))
        callback(None)

    def _refresh_all(self) -> None:
        for refresh in self._refreshers:
            refresh()

    @staticmethod
    def _header() -> str:
        return ("<div style='background-color:#1a1033;background-image:linear-gradient(120deg,#140c2b,#3a0f4f 70%,#ff2e93 160%);"
                "color:#fff;padding:16px 22px;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:8px;font-family:Segoe UI,system-ui,sans-serif'>"
                "<div style='font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#00e5ff;font-weight:700'>LOGIEXPRESS · PLANIFICADOR</div>"
                "<div style='font-size:22px;font-weight:800'>🚚 Planificador de rutas de entrega</div>"
                "<div style='color:#d9cdf5;font-size:13px'>Cambia cualquier opción y todo se recalcula al instante · "
                "reporta trancones o cierres en 🚧 · usa ▶ en las pestañas 🎬 para ver los algoritmos en acción</div></div>")

5.5 ⌨️ Interfaz de consola¶

La misma funcionalidad en un menú de texto. Es la prueba de que la arquitectura funciona: la consola y la GUI comparten el 100 % del núcleo.

  • Cada opción del menú es un comando (MenuOption); agregar opciones no modifica el ciclo principal (principio abierto/cerrado).
  • input_fn y output_fn se inyectan: en producción son input y print, y en las pruebas, respuestas simuladas.
  • Las entradas inválidas se vuelven a pedir en lugar de romper el programa.
In [13]:
def format_table(headers: Sequence[str], rows: Iterable[Sequence[object]], align: str) -> str:
    """Tabla de texto simple. `align` es un carácter por columna: '<' izquierda, '>' derecha."""
    body = [[str(cell) for cell in row] for row in rows]
    widths = [max(len(header), *(len(row[i]) for row in body)) if body else len(header)
              for i, header in enumerate(headers)]

    def line(cells: Sequence[str]) -> str:
        return "  ".join(f"{cell:{a}{w}}" for cell, a, w in zip(cells, align, widths))

    separator = "  ".join("─" * width for width in widths)
    return "\n".join([line(headers), separator, *(line(row) for row in body)])


class ConsoleRenderer:
    """Formatea entidades y resultados como texto para la consola."""

    def locations(self, network: RoadNetwork) -> str:
        rows = [(index, location.code, location.name, "🏭 Centro" if location.is_hub else "Barrio")
                for index, location in enumerate(network.locations, start=1)]
        return "📍 UBICACIONES\n" + format_table(("#", "Código", "Nombre", "Tipo"), rows, "><<<")

    def routes(self, network: RoadNetwork, conditions: RoadConditions | None = None) -> str:
        rows = []
        for route in network.roads():
            arrow = "↔" if network.is_two_way(route) else "→"
            status = conditions.status_of(route.origin, route.destination) if conditions else RoadStatus.NORMAL
            rows.append((f"{route.origin} {arrow} {route.destination}", route.street,
                         format_number(route.distance_km, "km"), format_number(route.time_min, "min", 0),
                         "" if status is RoadStatus.NORMAL else f"{status.icon} {status.label}"))
        return "🛣️  RUTAS (↔ doble sentido, → un sentido; tiempos en condiciones normales)\n" + format_table(
            ("Tramo", "Vía", "Distancia", "Tiempo", "Estado"), rows, "<<>><")

    def path(self, network: RoadNetwork, result: PathResult, title: str | None = None) -> str:
        origin = network.location(result.origin)
        destination = network.location(result.destination)
        header = title or f"🚚 Ruta más corta por {result.criterion.label.lower()}"
        lines = [f"{header}: {origin} → {destination}"]

        if not result.is_reachable:
            lines.append("   ❌ No existe una ruta entre estos puntos.")
            return "\n".join(lines)

        lines.append("   " + " ─▶ ".join(result.stops))
        lines.append(f"   Paradas: {len(result.stops)} | "
                     f"Distancia: {format_number(result.total_distance_km, 'km')} | "
                     f"Tiempo: {format_number(result.total_time_min, 'min', 0)}")
        rows = [(n, f"{leg.origin} → {leg.destination}", leg.street,
                 format_number(leg.distance_km, "km"), format_number(leg.time_min, "min", 0))
                for n, leg in enumerate(result.legs, start=1)]
        table = format_table(("#", "Tramo", "Vía", "Distancia", "Tiempo"), rows, "><<>>")
        lines.append("\n".join("   " + row for row in table.splitlines()))
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def recommendation(self, network: RoadNetwork, recommendation: RouteRecommendation) -> str:
        parts = [self.path(network, recommendation.recommended, "⭐ Ruta RECOMENDADA"),
                 f"   💡 {recommendation.reason}"]
        if not recommendation.routes_match:
            parts += ["", self.path(network, recommendation.fastest, "⏱️  Alternativa más rápida"),
                      "", self.path(network, recommendation.shortest, "📏 Alternativa más corta")]
        return "\n".join(parts)

    def routes_from(self, network: RoadNetwork, results: Sequence[PathResult], origin: str) -> str:
        criterion = results[0].criterion if results else Criterion.TIME
        rows = [(result.destination, network.location(result.destination).name,
                 " → ".join(result.stops) if result.is_reachable else "inalcanzable",
                 format_number(result.total_distance_km, "km"),
                 format_number(result.total_time_min, "min", 0))
                for result in results]
        title = (f"🌐 Todas las rutas desde {network.location(origin)} "
                 f"(Dijkstra, optimizando {criterion.label.lower()})")
        return title + "\n" + format_table(("Destino", "Nombre", "Ruta", "Distancia", "Tiempo"),
                                           rows, "<<<>>")

    def delivery(self, network: RoadNetwork, report: DeliveryReport) -> str:
        best = report.best
        crit = best.criterion
        lines = [f"📦 Reparto desde {network.location(best.depot)}: {len(best.order)} paradas "
                 f"(optimizando {crit.label.lower()})"]
        if not best.is_feasible:
            lines.append("   ❌ Hay paradas inalcanzables con las condiciones actuales.")
            return "\n".join(lines)
        lines.append("   Recorrido: " + " → ".join(best.sequence))
        lines.append(f"   Distancia: {format_number(best.total_distance_km, 'km')} | "
                     f"Tiempo: {format_number(best.total_time_min, 'min', 0)}")
        rows = [(plan.strategy.label, plan.strategy.complexity, " → ".join(plan.order),
                 f"{crit.format(plan.cost)} {crit.unit}") for plan in report.plans]
        table = format_table(("Estrategia", "Complejidad", "Orden de paradas", "Costo"), rows, "<<<>")
        lines.append("\n".join("   " + row for row in table.splitlines()))
        return "\n".join(lines)

    def all_pairs_matrix(self, all_pairs: AllPairsShortestPaths) -> str:
        rows = [(code, *("·" if i == j else all_pairs.criterion.format(value)
                         for j, value in enumerate(row)))
                for i, (code, row) in enumerate(zip(all_pairs.codes, all_pairs.matrix()))]
        title = (f"🧮 Matriz de costos mínimos entre todos los pares (Floyd-Warshall, "
                 f"{all_pairs.criterion.label.lower()} en {all_pairs.criterion.unit})\n"
                 f"   Fila = origen, columna = destino.")
        return title + "\n" + format_table(("De\\A", *all_pairs.codes), rows,
                                           "<" + ">" * len(all_pairs.codes))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class MenuOption:
    key: str
    label: str
    action: Callable[[], None]


class ConsoleApp:
    """Interfaz de consola del sistema de rutas de LogiExpress."""

    EXIT_KEY = "0"

    def __init__(
        self,
        service: RouteService,
        renderer: ConsoleRenderer,
        plotter: NetworkPlotter | None = None,
        input_fn: Callable[[str], str] = input,
        output_fn: Callable[[str], None] = print,
    ) -> None:
        self._service = service
        self._renderer = renderer
        self._plotter = plotter
        self._input = input_fn
        self._output = output_fn
        self._criterion = Criterion.TIME
        self._options = (
            MenuOption("1", "Ver ubicaciones y rutas", self._show_network),
            MenuOption("2", "Ruta más corta entre dos puntos", self._shortest_route),
            MenuOption("3", "Recomendar ruta (compara distancia vs. tiempo)", self._recommend),
            MenuOption("4", "Todas las rutas desde un origen (Dijkstra)", self._routes_from),
            MenuOption("5", "Rutas entre todos los pares (Floyd-Warshall)", self._all_pairs),
            MenuOption("6", "Cambiar criterio de optimización", self._toggle_criterion),
            MenuOption("7", "Reportar tráfico o cierre en una vía", self._report_incident),
            MenuOption("8", "Quitar todos los incidentes", self._clear_incidents),
            MenuOption("9", "Planear reparto con varias paradas", self._plan_delivery),
        )

    # Ciclo principal ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def run(self) -> None:
        self._output("═" * 60 + "\n   🚚  LogiExpress · Sistema de Gestión de Rutas\n" + "═" * 60)
        actions = {option.key: option.action for option in self._options}
        while True:
            self._output(self._menu())
            choice = self._input("Elige una opción: ").strip()
            if choice == self.EXIT_KEY:
                self._output("👋 ¡Gracias por usar LogiExpress!")
                return
            action = actions.get(choice)
            if action is None:
                self._output("⚠️  Opción no válida, intenta de nuevo.")
                continue
            try:
                action()
            except LogiExpressError as error:   # errores de negocio: se informan, no se cae
                self._output(f"⚠️  {error}")

    def _menu(self) -> str:
        incidents = len(self._service.conditions.incidents())
        lines = [f"\nCriterio actual: {self._criterion.label} ({self._criterion.unit})"
                 + (f" · 🚧 {incidents} incidente(s) activo(s)" if incidents else "")]
        lines += [f"  {option.key}. {option.label}" for option in self._options]
        lines.append(f"  {self.EXIT_KEY}. Salir")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    # Acciones del menú -------------------------------------------------------------
    def _show_network(self) -> None:
        base, conditions = self._service.base_network, self._service.conditions
        self._output(self._renderer.locations(base) + "\n\n" + self._renderer.routes(base, conditions))
        if self._plotter:
            self._plotter.plot_network(self._service.network, self._criterion, conditions)

    def _shortest_route(self) -> None:
        origin, destination = self._ask_origin_and_destination()
        result = self._service.shortest_route(origin, destination, self._criterion)
        self._output(self._renderer.path(self._service.network, result))
        if self._plotter and result.is_reachable:
            self._plotter.plot_path(self._service.network, result, self._service.conditions)

    def _recommend(self) -> None:
        origin, destination = self._ask_origin_and_destination()
        recommendation = self._service.recommend(origin, destination)
        self._output(self._renderer.recommendation(self._service.network, recommendation))
        if self._plotter and recommendation.recommended.is_reachable:
            self._plotter.plot_path(self._service.network, recommendation.recommended,
                                    self._service.conditions)

    def _routes_from(self) -> None:
        origin = self._ask_location("Origen")
        results = self._service.routes_from(origin, self._criterion)
        self._output(self._renderer.routes_from(self._service.network, results, origin))
        if self._plotter:
            self._plotter.plot_routes_from(self._service.network, results, origin, self._service.conditions)

    def _all_pairs(self) -> None:
        all_pairs = self._service.all_pairs(self._criterion)
        self._output(self._renderer.all_pairs_matrix(all_pairs))
        if self._plotter:
            self._plotter.plot_all_pairs(all_pairs)

    def _toggle_criterion(self) -> None:
        self._criterion = self._criterion.toggled()
        self._output(f"✅ Ahora se optimiza por {self._criterion.label.lower()}.")

    def _report_incident(self) -> None:
        self._output("Indica los dos extremos de la vía afectada.")
        origin, destination = self._ask_origin_and_destination()
        status = self._ask_status()
        self._service.report_incident(origin, destination, status)
        self._output(f"✅ {origin}–{destination}: {status.icon} {status.label}. "
                     "Las rutas ya tienen en cuenta el incidente.")

    def _clear_incidents(self) -> None:
        self._service.clear_incidents()
        self._output("🟢 Todas las vías vuelven a la normalidad.")

    def _plan_delivery(self) -> None:
        depot = self._ask_location("Centro de salida")
        stops = self._ask_stops(depot)
        round_trip = self._ask_yes_no("¿Regresar al centro al final? (s/n)")
        report = self._service.plan_delivery(depot, stops, self._criterion, return_to_depot=round_trip)
        self._output(self._renderer.delivery(self._service.network, report))
        if self._plotter and report.best.is_feasible:
            self._plotter.plot_delivery(self._service.network, report.best, self._service.conditions)

    # Lectura de datos del usuario ------------------------------------------------------
    def _ask_origin_and_destination(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        origin = self._ask_location("Origen")
        while True:
            destination = self._ask_location("Destino")
            if destination != origin:
                return origin, destination
            self._output("⚠️  El destino debe ser distinto del origen.")

    def _ask_location(self, label: str) -> str:
        locations = self._service.network.locations
        options = "  ".join(f"{i}.{loc.code}" for i, loc in enumerate(locations, start=1))
        self._output(f"\n{options}")
        while True:
            answer = self._input(f"{label} (número o código): ").strip().upper()
            if answer.isdigit() and 1 <= int(answer) <= len(locations):
                return locations[int(answer) - 1].code
            if answer in self._service.network:
                return answer
            self._output(f"⚠️  '{answer}' no es una ubicación válida.")

    def _ask_stops(self, depot: str) -> list[str]:
        locations = self._service.network.locations
        while True:
            answer = self._input("Paradas (números o códigos separados por coma): ")
            stops, unknown = [], []
            for token in (part.strip().upper() for part in answer.replace(";", ",").split(",")):
                if not token:
                    continue
                if token.isdigit() and 1 <= int(token) <= len(locations):
                    token = locations[int(token) - 1].code
                (stops if token in self._service.network else unknown).append(token)
            if unknown:
                self._output(f"⚠️  No reconozco: {', '.join(unknown)}")
                continue
            stops = list(dict.fromkeys(code for code in stops if code != depot))  # sin repetidos
            if stops:
                return stops
            self._output("⚠️  Indica al menos una parada distinta del centro.")

    def _ask_yes_no(self, label: str) -> bool:
        while True:
            answer = self._input(f"{label}: ").strip().lower()
            if answer in {"s", "si", "sí", "y"}:
                return True
            if answer in {"n", "no"}:
                return False
            self._output("⚠️  Responde 's' o 'n'.")

    def _ask_status(self) -> RoadStatus:
        statuses = list(RoadStatus)
        self._output("  ".join(f"{i}. {s.icon} {s.label}" for i, s in enumerate(statuses, start=1)))
        while True:
            answer = self._input("Estado de la vía (número): ").strip()
            if answer.isdigit() and 1 <= int(answer) <= len(statuses):
                return statuses[int(answer) - 1]
            self._output(f"⚠️  '{answer}' no es un estado válido.")

6 · ✅ Pruebas automáticas¶

Verifican que el sistema es correcto antes de usarlo. La prueba estrella es la validación cruzada: Dijkstra y Floyd-Warshall son algoritmos totalmente distintos, así que si coinciden en los 156 pares con ambos criterios, es muy probable que los dos estén bien implementados.
